name: free-rein-repo
description: Free Rein: the core (core/), the VS Code extension (vscode/), and Free Rein's data (model/). Each has its own package; these scripts run them together.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix core && npm ci --prefix vscode && npm run hooks
scripts.test: npm test --prefix core && npm test --prefix vscode
scripts.hooks: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
